findings.evidence: `scheduler.Extension` now requires `ModifyMeta` (`pkg/disttask/framework/scheduler/interface.go:134`) and `BaseScheduler.onModifying` invokes it for any non-concurrency modifications (`pkg/disttask/framework/scheduler/scheduler.go:423`). `pkg/disttask/example/scheduler.go` sets `s.BaseScheduler.Extension = s` (`pkg/disttask/example/scheduler.go:53`) but defines no explicit `ModifyMeta` method; because `BaseScheduler` embeds the `Extension` interface (`pkg/disttask/framework/scheduler/scheduler.go:85`), the promoted forwarding method will call back into `BaseScheduler.Extension`, causing self-recursive dispatch when meta modifications are requested.
findings.fix: Add an explicit no-op `ModifyMeta` to `pkg/disttask/example/scheduler.go` (and any other scheduler impl using `BaseScheduler.Extension = self`), e.g. `func (*schedulerImpl) ModifyMeta(oldMeta []byte, _ []proto.Modification) ([]byte, error) { return oldMeta, nil }`.
findings.impact: If `TaskManager.ModifyTaskByID` is used with any non-`modify_concurrency` modification on `TaskTypeExample`, the scheduler can hit infinite recursion/stack overflow during `onModifying`, crashing the scheduler goroutine and potentially leaving the task stuck in `modifying` (until another owner recovers it).
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed on `upstream/master` (f0813a369666ac6314e76f5e573e982fe50c8a09): `pkg/dxf/example/scheduler.go:53` still assigns `BaseScheduler.Extension = s` and still lacks `ModifyMeta`, while the interface still requires it (`pkg/dxf/framework/scheduler/interface.go:151`).
findings.verify: Create a `TaskTypeExample` task, call `TaskManager.ModifyTaskByID` with a non-concurrency modification (e.g. `ModifyMaxWriteSpeed`), and confirm the scheduler no longer stack-overflows and the task transitions out of `modifying` (and meta updates if implemented).
findings.what: `TaskTypeExample` scheduler lacks an explicit `ModifyMeta` implementation; due to `BaseScheduler` embedding/forwarding `Extension`, calling `ModifyMeta` during task modification can recurse into itself and crash.

subject: dxf: support modify app param on scheduler part (#58990)
summary: This commit wires non-concurrency task modifications through `scheduler.Extension.ModifyMeta` (persisting updated `task.Meta` via `ModifiedTask`) and adds new modification types for add-index app params. DDL backfill/import schedulers provide no-op `ModifyMeta`, but the Example scheduler omits an explicit `ModifyMeta`, creating a recursion/stack-overflow hazard when meta modifications are requested.
